title: KAZU K20
features:
This Script by KAZU is not just a project – it’s a gateway to becoming unstoppable. 
A powerful transformation system where you unleash monstrous forms, each evolution more terrifying and unstoppable than the last. 
From shadow beasts to elemental titans, every monster form grants new abilities, speed, and strength beyond limits. 
With every transformation, your aura grows darker, your power more uncontainable, until you stand as the true apex predator.  

KAZU’s Admin Awakening: Unlock hidden powers only reserved for legends. 
Summon forbidden commands, bend the rules of reality, and walk as a god among players. 
This script grants you access to abilities once thought untouchable – infinite energy, instant mastery, and domination over the world around you.  

Features:
-- Autofarm --
Autofarm - (Quest, No Quest, Multi Quest, Fruit Mastery, Farm Ectoplasm)
Autofarm Distance
Auto Skills
Bring Mobs
Auto Haki
Fast Attack
Super Fast Attack
Attack reach
Auto Attack - (Default KeyBind E)
Player ESP - (Box, Tracers, Names, Distance)
Devil Fruit ESP
Chest ESP

-- Raid --
Kill Aura
Auto Next Island
Auto Start Raid - (Select Raid)
Auto Awake

-- Misc --
Auto Buy Legendary Sword
Auto Buy Enchantment
Walk Speed
Jump Power
Inf Soru - (Key Bind == R)
Soru Distance Changer
Walk On Water
Inf Energy
Inf Ability
No Dodge Cooldown
Inf Jump
Remove Lava
Noclip
Quick Join Marines
Quick Join Pirates
Enter 1, 2, 3 Sea
Check Ectoplasm
Open Devil Fruit Shop
Open Inventory
Open Fruit Inventory

-- Fruits --
Devil Fruit Sniper -- (Auto Buys Selected Fruit if it is on stock)
Bring Fruits
Auto Store Fruits
Buy Random Fruit
Auto Buy Random Fruit

-- Items --
Buy Skyjump
Buy Buso Haki
Buy Soru
Buy All Fighting Styles
Buy All Swords -- (Shows Prices)

-- Teleport --
Teleport to selected area

-- Points --
Auto Put Points on Melee, Defence, Sword, Gun, Devil Fruit

-- Extra --
Server Hop
Rejoin
Destroy GUI

This is more than a script – this is KAZU’s evolution, domination, and chaos merged into one unstoppable force. 
Do you have what it takes to control it… or will the power consume you?
